searchText: yeah thanks for bringing this up, i think GET would be cleaner. Originally the endpoint was designed to submit to BN, and we removed that but didn't think about changing the method to GET. I also added a "data" layer in the response body which wasn't intentional 🤦‍♂️ and made it a bit inconvenient to use with the BN endpoint but seeing that most clients have already implemented it (and some tools already integrated with it), i wasn't sure if it's worth the change but you also brought up a good point that the keymanager API release hasn't happened yet .. not sure if it's worth it tbh, given that it's a breaking change and 3 clients have this implemented to spec, (lighthouse isn't spec-compliant) so it might be slightly annoying for users, but keen to hear thoughts the nice thing would be it's just a normal HTTP get your browser could do, but its not super awful... im not against changing it, could make a get, deprecate the post...
